description: Parses a CommonMark / GFM Markdown string into an ordered list of IPageBlock objects. Supports headings, paragraphs, bullet lists, numbered lists, task lists, blockquotes, fenced code blocks, horizontal rules, images, block equations, GFM tables and inline formatting. A table becomes one BlockType.Table block plus child BlockType.TableRow blocks whose ParentBlockId points at it — the same shape TmNotionTableBlock loads at runtime. Outer pipes are optional, escaped \| stays cell content, and the separator row's alignment (:---, :---:, ---:) is captured in TableBlockContent.ColumnAlignments. Untrusted text is HTML-encoded and link/image URLs are restricted to http, https, mailto and relative targets, so raw <script> or javascript: payloads cannot survive the import.

members.name: InlineMarkdownToHtml
members.description: Converts CommonMark inline elements to HTML for storage in block content. Everything that is not generated markup is HTML-encoded, and link/image URLs are restricted to http, https, mailto and relative targets.
